prompt: A scaled reptilian beast stands in side profile facing south-west on cracked stone ground. Its hind half is deep emerald green with vivid scales, but its front half has been drained of all color into a flat bone-gray colorless husk, the boundary a sharp washing line where vivid color fades to gray. Its bleached head and shoulders are dissolving into drifting white motes of light, crumbling away as if erased. The only source of light is the cold white glow of the dissolving edge. The background is a dim grey temple hall.

A vivid crimson-and-gold winged serpent recoils, its body caught mid-transformation: the color visibly bleaching out of it from the head down, the front already a flat colorless gray stone-like husk while the tail still glows red. The gray bleached portion is crumbling into a spray of white motes and light, being erased into nothing. Cold white luminescence pours from the dissolving line. The background is a shadowed cathedral interior in muted blue-grey.

A snarling wolf in side profile, its body turning into pale white alabaster marble statue from the head forward, petrified and colorless, while its haunches and tail still show vivid grey-brown fur with the color visibly bleeding away. The white marble portion is cracking and crumbling into drifting white dust and motes of light, eroding into nothing. The only light is the cold white glow of the crumbling stone. The background is a dim grey stone hall.

A white-robed cleric in side profile pours a stream of luminous glowing white liquid from a clay jug over a cowering green lizard creature. Where the white liquid runs down the lizard, its green color washes away to pale colorless grey, and the drenched front of the creature dissolves into white motes and steam, being erased. The only source of light is the glowing white liquid. The background is a shadowed temple interior in muted blue-grey.

A snarling wolf in side profile, its body turning into pale white alabaster marble statue from the head forward, petrified and colorless, while its haunches and tail still show vivid grey-brown fur with the color visibly bleeding away. The white marble head and shoulders are visibly disintegrating into a cloud of drifting white dust and glowing white motes, eroding into empty white nothingness at the edge. The only light is the cold white glow of the crumbling stone. The background is a dim grey stone hall.

A roaring beast carved entirely of pale colorless white alabaster stone stands in side profile, mid-disintegration: its head and forequarters are shattering and crumbling apart into a billowing cloud of white dust, broken stone shards, and glowing white motes that scatter upward and dissolve into nothing. The intact rear of the beast retains a faint trace of vivid colored scales, the last color draining out. The only source of light is the cold white glow of the disintegrating stone. The background is a dim grey temple hall.

A roaring wolf carved of pale colorless white alabaster stone stands in clean side profile, its sharp snarling head and shoulders intact and crisply defined, but its hindquarters and tail shattering and crumbling apart into a billowing cloud of white dust, broken stone shards, and glowing white motes that scatter upward and dissolve into nothing. A faint trace of vivid colored fur remains on the intact head, the last color draining out. The only source of light is the cold white glow of the disintegrating stone. The background is a dim grey temple hall.
